info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Borax Notebook Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Catalog Borax Notebook Detail Management API enables businesses to efficiently create and manage detailed entries for Borax notebooks in their product catalog. This API supports the addition of new notebook details, including specifications and features, streamlining the cataloging process. Ideal for developers working on inventory management, e-commerce platforms, or product information systems, this API enhances product visibility and organization. Utilize this API to improve user experience by providing comprehensive product information at scale.

post.summary: Create a new detail for a Borax notebook.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new detail entry for a specific Borax notebook. The detail will be associated with the notebook and can include various attributes that describe the content or updates relevant to that notebook.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary information to create or update the details of a borax notebook. Please ensure that all required fields are included and formatted correctly.
